name: ChurnDesk
overview: AI-powered customer support and incident response platform for ticket investigation, resolution coordination, and escalation.
problem: Subscription businesses frequently discover customer dissatisfaction only after cancellation has already occurred.
solution: ChurnDesk helps teams investigate support tickets, retrieve relevant information, coordinate resolutions, and escalate issues that need human attention.
architecture: A React and TypeScript dashboard consumes Python FastAPI endpoints for account health, engagement events, and retention analytics. PostgreSQL stores customer and activity records.
features: At-risk customer notification hooks and alerts

design_decisions.reason: Keeps the backend in Python and validates event and account data at the API boundary.
Delivers a modern, dense data-display layout with high contrast and readable metrics.

challenges.challenge: Computing health scores efficiently across thousands of activity events
challenges.solution: Scheduled batch aggregation jobs that compute rolling 7-day and 30-day window metrics into summary tables.

contributions: Full-Stack Developer — implemented the event ingestion endpoint, FastAPI API layer, and retention dashboard.
additional_context: ChurnDesk is an AI-powered customer support and incident response platform that investigates tickets, retrieves relevant information, coordinates resolutions, and escalates issues requiring human attention.
